_comment: The look of the bar: day (the normal light look), night (a dark look) or auto (night by the clock, see below). Default day = today's look. Read at server start (--look-config to use another file).
_comment_night: auto: night from..to by the Pi's wall clock (local time, fixed hours, no location). If from is later than to the night wraps over midnight; if from equals to there is never a night (auto always shows day). The Pi has no RTC and its clock starts at the system's build date, so the server (started with --clock-sync, as pi/revview.service does) counts the clock as set only when systemd-timesyncd's file /run/systemd/timesync/synchronized exists; until then auto shows day. A laptop without that switch only checks that the year is 2026 or later. The Settings row and the menu hold change the look (kept over a restart when the server is started with --settings: npm start, npm run start:dev and pi/revview.service do; this file is the default).
